entities.summary: Jorge Lozano is a retired professional tennis player from Mexico. He reached his highest doubles ranking of World No. 4 in August 1988. His highest singles ranking was World No. 51, achieved the following month. Jorge Lozano was a athletes & competitors from San Luis Potosí (b. 1963-05-17, San Luis Potosí). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
